Subject: Transfer Policy for Group ‘C’ Cadres in EPFO, 2025- reg

Reference: Head Office circular no. HRD-I/87/2024/TransferPolicyReview/Misc/1227

Sir/Madam,

Certain clarifications/modifications are being made in the Transfer Policy for Group ‘C’

Cadres, 2025. The same are hereby circulated for information and necessary action:

a) The Transfer Policy shall apply to all Group ‘C’ employees.

b) It is clarified that the transfer of Social Security Assistants (SSAs) after completion of 10
years of service in a particular office is not mandatory according to Transfer Policy for
Group ‘C’ cadre, 2025. However, each Zone must ensure equitable and judicious
distribution of manpower across all its Regional and District Offices, so that the work of

any office does not suffer due to inadequate staffing in comparison to other offices.
